faqs.q: How many golf courses are near Da Nang?
faqs.a: Da Nang and the surrounding Central Coast region has over 10 championship golf courses within a 90-minute drive, making it one of the highest concentrations of top-tier golf in Asia. Asia Golf Specialists focuses on the 4–6 finest layouts for our Da Nang itineraries.

faqs.q: What is the best golf course in Da Nang?
faqs.a: Hoiana Shores Golf Club is consistently ranked as Vietnam's number one course and is the centrepiece of most AGS Da Nang itineraries. Ba Na Hills Golf Club offers a spectacular mountain setting and night golf. BRG Đà Nẵng and Montgomerie Links complete a world-class coastal circuit.

faqs.q: How do I book golf in Da Nang through Asia Golf Specialists?
faqs.a: Contact AGS via our quote request form. We secure guaranteed tee times at all Da Nang courses as part of a fully bespoke itinerary — including private villas, luxury transfers, and cultural experiences. We do not book standalone tee times.

faqs.q: Where should I stay for golf in Da Nang?
faqs.a: The Hoiana resort precinct places you minutes from Hoiana Shores and 30 minutes from Ba Na Hills and BRG. For the An Bang and Hoi An experience, AGS's private villa portfolio offers pool-villa options with direct beach access. We match accommodation to your itinerary priorities.

faqs.q: What is the best time of year to golf in Da Nang?
faqs.a: February through September is Da Nang's prime golf season. The October–January window brings the Northeast Monsoon and can result in wet conditions. AGS strongly recommends the March–May window as the peak comfort zone.

Da Nang has earned its place among the world's elite golf destinations. This Central Vietnamese city — perched between the South China Sea and the Trường Sơn mountains — is home to four of Vietnam's finest championship golf courses within a 30-minute radius, all available through a single curated itinerary with Asia Golf Specialists.

If you're planning a luxury golf trip to Southeast Asia, Da Nang belongs at the top of your shortlist. Here's everything you need to know.

Why Da Nang Has Become the Capital of Vietnamese Golf

Three factors have made Da Nang the country's premier golf hub. First, the course quality: designers of the calibre of Robert Trent Jones Jr., Nick Faldo, and the late European design movement have created genuinely world-class layouts here. Second, the infrastructure: international direct flights from Australia (via Singapore, Bangkok, or Ho Chi Minh City) and a mature five-star resort ecosystem mean logistics are seamless. Third, the value: green fees and villa rates at Da Nang's finest properties remain significantly more accessible than comparable experiences in Thailand or Bali.

The Four Signature Courses

Hoiana Shores Golf Club

Vietnam's first true links course. Designed by Robert Trent Jones Jr. on a dramatic dune landscape adjacent to the East Sea, Hoiana Shores plays to 7,309 yards from the back tees and demands creativity and course management throughout. The closing stretch along the beach is among the finest in Asian golf. Consistently ranked Vietnam's number-one layout.

Ba Na Hills Golf Club

Designed by Luke Donald on a mountain plateau at 1,500 metres elevation, Ba Na Hills offers something that no other Da Nang course can match: night golf. Fully floodlit from 5:30pm, the experience of playing a Luke Donald design in the Vietnamese highlands after dark is genuinely extraordinary. The course also plays beautifully by day, with panoramic mountain views on every hole.

Laguna Golf Lăng Cô

Sir Nick Faldo’s brilliant design seamlessly weaves through dramatic jungle terrain, pristine beachfront, and serene rice paddies. The course’s strategic bunkering and unique environmental diversity make it a captivating challenge. Watch out for the resident water buffalo roaming the paddies as you navigate this truly immersive tropical layout.

BRG Legends Da Nang Golf Resort

Now a premier 36-hole facility, BRG Legends Da Nang Golf Resort features the formidable Nicklaus Course, a standout design by Jack Nicklaus II. The layout is defined by its striking wooden bulkheads that line the water hazards — a design element inspired by classic Florida courses but uniquely adapted to the Vietnamese coastal landscape. It demands absolute precision and offers a thrilling test for golfers of all levels.

Best Time to Visit Da Nang for Golf

February through September is Da Nang's prime golf window. The March–May window is the sweet spot — dry, warm (26–30°C), and uncrowded. See our full Vietnam golf season guide for month-by-month detail.

Where to Stay: Villas vs Resorts

AGS recommends private villas for groups of 4+ — price per person is comparable to resort accommodation but offers complete privacy, a private pool, and villa staff. Our An Bang villa portfolio places groups minutes from Hoiana Shores and adjacent to Vietnam's finest boutique dining strip.

For couples or smaller groups, the Hoiana resort precinct — anchored by the New World Hoiana Hotel — offers five-star facilities with direct course access. The An Bang Holiday Villa is our flagship villa property for the Da Nang circuit.
